turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Over the past few months I’ve felt progressively weaker and I’ve lost weight without trying. I also had previous blood work that showed elevated BUN and creatinine, but I haven’t had any infections, bleeding, or urinary changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any small raised skin bumps with a central dimple. I mostly just feel progressively weaker and I’ve had unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself or putting on your clothes lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—I can dress myself and manage my usual daily tasks, but I just feel weaker than before and it’s been getting worse over the past few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores on your skin specifically along the path of the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any specific rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. I mainly just feel progressively weaker and I’ve had unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any noticeable itchiness on my skin. My main issues are the progressive weakness and the unintentional weight loss over the past few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles when you walk that feels better after you stop and rest for a few minutes?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have calf pain or cramping when I walk that improves after I stop and rest—I’ve mainly been dealing with progressively worsening weakness and unintentional weight loss. I haven’t noticed any other specific symptoms with walking.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any changes in my stool color—no pale or clay-colored stools. My main concerns remain the progressive weakness and unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t had any specific weakness in my hands like trouble gripping things or opening jars—I’m able to do my usual daily tasks, but overall I just feel progressively weaker and have lost weight without trying.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t recall having any shaking episodes. I’ve mainly been feeling progressively weaker and losing weight without trying, and I’ve stayed aware of my surroundings.”
